scope: The eight files named as next by M44: der_writer and the seven DH units (asn1, backend, check, depr, gen, group_params, kdf). One dead-code correctness defect repaired in src/der_writer.rs and covered by a new focused test; the seven DH units are audited against the pinned openssl-3.6.4 authority with no source change. No new unsafe operation, FFI symbol, allocator coordinate, repr(C) layout or signature introduced.
worktree: source change: src/der_writer.rs (boolean writer, its test, and #[cfg(test)]); queue/receipt: REMAINING-AUDIT.txt, AUDITED-FILES.txt, PERFILE-INDEX.md section 50 and this file.

reconciliation.method: AUDITED-FILES.txt is the union of each mechanism sweep's structured .files array, the M1 files, the structured per-file records and each boundary sweep's structured boundaries. The eight audited files were removed from REMAINING-AUDIT.txt and merged in alphabetical order into AUDITED-FILES.txt.
reconciliation.difference_from_399: M45 moves exactly the eight named ordinary files; no file is skipped or substituted.

mechanisms: int_start_context / int_end_context tag guards and size comparison
ossl_DER_w_precompiled, octet_string, octet_string_uint32, uint32, bn, null, begin_sequence, end_sequence
ossl_DER_w_boolean sub-packet close and tag write
int_put_bytes_bn top-limb probe through bn_get_words and BN_bn2bin extent
file_dispositions.note: crypto/der_writer.c:17-198. Pre-edit :131 tested WPACKET_close(pkt) == 0 although the callee answers 1 on success; :132 tested the tag write for != 0 while the authority inverts that arm too (der_writer.c:60-68). The function has no caller in the authority or in this crate, so the defect is unobservable and no compatibility surface changes. Both tests now use the intended non-zero success semantics and the deliberate divergence from the pinned authority is recorded at the function. A null-packet test exercises b = 0 and b = 1, and the test module is now cfg(test) so the focused imports do not leak into the library build. The other eight writers match the authority line-for-line; the BN_bn2bin return check is a strictness addition over the authority and is unreachable for a non-negative BIGNUM.

mechanisms: DHparams/DHvparams/DHxparams ASN1_ITEM templates and item accessors
d2i_DHxparams translation ownership hand-off (p/q/g/j transfer, vparams release)
file_dispositions.note: dh_asn1.c:25-167. The decoded int_dhx942_dh block is owned by OwnedBlock, p/q/g transfer to DH_set0_pqg and j to ossl_ffc_params_set0_j, while seed/counter are freed and the vparams block released at the authority's :125 site before the outer block is dropped at :129; a full struct destructor is never run. The authority's uninitialised stack ASN1_BIT_STRING.type is zero-initialised and documented because the encoder never reads it. i2d_DHxparams frees the counter on the BN_set_word failure arm and on the shared err path exactly once.

mechanisms: ossl_dh_dup selection guards and ex_data duplication
ossl_dh_key_from_pkcs8 two-container decode and three exit labels
file_dispositions.note: dh_backend.c:31-242. The private import is BN_clear_free'd and the public BN_free'd on every refusal arm; PKCS#8 uses BN_secure_new, clears the key on conversion failure and ASN1_STRING_clear_free's the source integer on every exit. ossl_dh_dup reproduces the authority's (selection & DOMAIN_PARAMETERS) == 0 || guard and DH_set0_key's leave-private-alone rule; both are asserted by unit tests. No ownership escape or double release.

mechanisms: DH_check_ex / DH_check subgroup and safe-prime refinement
file_dispositions.note: dh_check.c:29-410. Reason order, |= refinement, the DH_get_nid fast path, BN_CTX start/end and free on every arm, and the OSSL_SELF_TEST onbegin/onend pairing match the authority. The private key is borrowed for the range and pairwise checks; no copy of secret material is created in this unit.

mechanisms: DH_generate_parameters deprecated wrapper and BN_GENCB ownership
file_dispositions.note: dh_depr.c:25-48. BN_GENCB is released before the DH object on the failure path and alone on success; the NULL callback is accepted exactly as BN_GENCB_set_old allows.

mechanisms: dh_builtin_genparams safe-prime construction and err label
file_dispositions.note: dh_gen.c:39-238. The generator bound is checked after p/g allocation, the three t1/t2 congruence pairs match, and the err label raises ERR_R_BN_LIB exactly once before BN_CTX_end/free (both accept NULL). No secret is handled here: p/g are public parameters.

dh_group_params.c:27-100. The setter's nid flush followed by dh_param_init's assignment is preserved; the cache installs q only when absent and shares BN_FLG_STATIC_DATA constants; uid 1..3 name the RFC 5114 groups. All matches the authority.

mechanisms: ossl_dh_kdf_X9_42_asn1 OSSL_PARAM array and EVP_KDF lifecycle
DH_KDF_X9_42 text-form OID and provider libctx
file_dispositions.note: dh_kdf.c:27-73. The five-slot parameter array is fully written in both the UKM and no-UKM shapes, and kctx/kdf are released on every arm. Z and ukm are borrowed read-only and passed straight to EVP_KDF_derive; this unit makes no secret copy and therefore owes no local cleansing. out is left as the authority leaves it on failure.

defects_repaired.summary: ossl_DER_w_boolean used WPACKET_close(pkt) == 0 (success is 1) and did not mirror the authority's inverted tag write. Corrected both arms to non-zero success, documented the deliberate divergence (the authority function is inverted and has no callers), and added a focused test.

new_unsafe_assumptions.note: No unsafe operation was added or moved. The only source change is control flow in a private dead function. int_put_bytes_uint32's SAFETY contract now names the alignment its u32 dereference requires and int_der_w_integer's names the callback contract; these make existing preconditions explicit, not new.
